resources.string: This chat always uses the AuthorGram system key. A custom key cannot be created here.
A custom encryption key is active for this chat.
This chat currently uses the AuthorGram system key.
Enter an encryption word that will be used to create the key.
Uppercase, lowercase, internal spaces and symbols matter. Leading and trailing spaces are ignored.
Custom key created. The other participant must enter the same encryption word.
The encryption word can contain at most 256 characters.
The custom key could not be created. The previous key remains active.
New messages will use the AuthorGram system key. The previous custom key will remain protected locally so older messages stay readable.
The AuthorGram system key is now active.
